intro.text: The US CPA (Certified Public Accountant) is a prestigious professional accounting license awarded by the relevant state boards of accountancy in the United States. The CPA qualification demonstrates professional competence in accounting, auditing, taxation, financial reporting, and related areas.

runs.text: The US CPA is an excellent pathway for students and accounting professionals who aspire to build careers in public accounting, multinational companies, Big Four accounting firms, financial services, and global finance operations.

runs.text: The Uniform CPA Examination consists of four sections: three Core sections and one Discipline section of your choice.

content.text: The Uniform CPA Examination consists of four sections: three Core sections and one Discipline section of your choice.
Core Sections
1. Auditing and Attestation (AUD)

runs.text: Understand auditing procedures, professional responsibilities, audit evidence, and the assessment of audit risks.

content.text: Understand auditing procedures, professional responsibilities, audit evidence, and the assessment of audit risks.
2. Financial Accounting and Reporting (FAR)

runs.text: Learn financial reporting, accounting principles, financial statements, and applicable US accounting standards.

content.text: Learn financial reporting, accounting principles, financial statements, and applicable US accounting standards.
3. Taxation and Regulation (REG)

runs.text: Study US federal taxation, business law, ethics, and professional responsibilities covered by the examination.

content.text: Study US federal taxation, business law, ethics, and professional responsibilities covered by the examination.
Choose One Discipline Section
4. Business Analysis and Reporting (BAR)

runs.text: Focus on advanced financial reporting, business analysis, and related accounting topics.

content.text: Focus on advanced financial reporting, business analysis, and related accounting topics.
OR
Information Systems and Controls (ISC)

runs.text: Develop knowledge of information systems, IT controls, data management, and related assurance topics.

content.text: Develop knowledge of information systems, IT controls, data management, and related assurance topics.
OR
Tax Compliance and Planning (TCP)

runs.text: Focus on tax compliance, tax planning, and related individual and entity taxation topics.
